BodyPose3D.description: Authoritative body-center pose in board-local world units; rotation is degrees in fixed Euler YXZ order (Ry * Rx * Rz). No scale.

rotation.description: Optional editor yaw in degrees around world Y; no electrical meaning.

control_client_id.description: Non-secret, volatile per-tab control context. Bound to the authenticated server session; never an authentication token. Omit for a view-only stream.

ExperimentActiveSnapshot.description: Owner-scoped active, unstarted and quarantined records. Admitted executions precede CREATED records. Follow next_cursor explicitly; snapshots never authorize control or replay execution.

FlexibleLeadIntent.description: Ordered board-local world-space bend intent from body exit toward the named contact; endpoints derive from the descriptor and contact.

node_id.description: Deprecated fixed observed node only; never a teacher reference node.

MechanicalAuthoringProfileV1.description: Versioned authoring limits and body exits. These are design geometry limits, not observed hardware ratings or safety evidence.

MemoryImage.$comment: Consumers must also check data.length === depth. This local initial image is not a capture or physical RAM capability.

PublicStationCapabilities.$comment: Public projection intentionally excludes station resource/node maps. Internal StationCapabilities remains the hardware-service contract.

WirePoint3.$comment: Legacy visual coordinates preserve opaque point extensions; mounting coordinates remain strict.
